title: Chicken Schnitzel
description: A classic Continental chicken schnitzel featuring thinly pounded chicken breasts coated in crisp golden breadcrumbs and shallow-fried until perfectly crunchy. Served with lemon wedges and traditional accompaniments.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken
items: Boneless chicken breasts – 4 pieces (approx. 180–200 g each)
Dijon mustard – 1 tsp (optional, for added flavor)

ingredients.title: For the Coating
items: Parmesan cheese (grated) – 2 tbsp (optional, for extra crispness and flavor)

ingredients.title: For Frying
items: Clarified butter or neutral oil – for shallow frying (approx. 200 ml)

ingredients.title: For Garnish & Serving
items: Classic accompaniments: potato salad, mashed potatoes, or buttered vegetables

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Chicken
steps: Trim chicken breasts and butterfly them horizontally.
Place between two sheets of plastic wrap and gently pound with a meat mallet until about ¼ inch (6 mm) thick.
Season both sides with salt, pepper, lemon juice, and mustard (if using).

instruction.title: Step 2 – Breading Procedure
steps: Dredge each schnitzel in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip into the egg-milk mixture ensuring even coating.
Finally, coat with breadcrumbs (and Parmesan, if using).
Press gently to help the crumbs adhere well.
Lay on a tray and chill for 10–15 minutes (helps coating stay intact).

instruction.title: Step 3 – Cooking
steps: Heat clarified butter or oil in a wide sauté pan over medium-high heat (approx. 170–175°C).
Fry schnitzels one or two at a time, 2–3 minutes per side, until golden brown and crisp.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Serving & Presentation
steps: Plate the schnitzel slightly overlapping or at an angle.
Garnish with a lemon wedge and fresh parsley.
Serve with potato salad, buttered vegetables, or a light cucumber-dill salad for a Continental-style presentation.
Optionally drizzle with a touch of brown butter and capers for an elevated restaurant finish.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve with potato salad, mashed potatoes, or buttered vegetables.
Add a light cucumber-dill salad for a Continental-style presentation.
Serve immediately with fresh lemon wedges.

chefTips: Use clarified butter for authentic flavor and even browning.
Rest the fried schnitzels on a wire rack to stay crisp.
For a gourmet twist, pair with cranberry compote or mustard cream sauce.
